IERS_C04_14.description: IERS EOP 14 C04, the long-term combined solution (e.g. eopc04_14_IAU2000.62-now.txt).

IERS_C04_20.description: IERS EOP 20 C04, the ITRF2020-based combined solution.

IERS_BULLETIN_A.description: IERS Bulletin A rapid service / prediction.

FINALS2000A.description: USNO/IERS finals2000A combined rapid + prediction file.

OTHER.description: A series not covered above; identify it in a producer-defined way.

COMPUTE_ACCESS_WINDOWS.description: Compute access windows from pre-sampled target Cartesian states.

SIMULATE_OBSERVATIONS.description: Simulate sensor observations of TARGETS by SENSORS: schedule tracks inside the ACCESS windows (computed per sensor and target by COMPUTE_ACCESS_WINDOWS with that sensor's constraints), generate each measurement from the truth states with its MEMErrorModel noise and bias, apply the detection test, and add false alarms. The observations are emitted as separate $RDO (RADAR), $EOO (OPTICAL, LASER_RANGING) and $RFO (PASSIVE_RF) records; the result lists the tracks.

INVALID_INPUT.description: Request fields are missing, non-finite, or numerically invalid.

UNSUPPORTED_OPERATION.description: The requested operation is not supported by the module.

MIN_ELEVATION.description: Observer-to-target elevation at or above THRESHOLD_RAD (ground observers).

MAX_RANGE.description: Observer-to-target range at or below MAX_RANGE_M.

MIN_RANGE.description: Observer-to-target range at or above MIN_RANGE_M.

SUN_EXCLUSION.description: Angle between the observer-to-target and observer-to-Sun directions at or above THRESHOLD_RAD (solar exclusion).

MOON_EXCLUSION.description: Angle between the observer-to-target and observer-to-Moon directions at or above THRESHOLD_RAD (lunar exclusion).

LINE_OF_SIGHT.description: Straight-line visibility between observer and target not occulted by the central body raised by OCCULTATION_ATMOSPHERE_HEIGHT_M (satellite-to-satellite).

ANY_OF.description: At least one member must hold (OR).

DISCRETE.description: Evaluate at the supplied sample epochs only; window edges are samples.

CONTINUOUS.description: Bracket between samples and refine each edge to ROOT_TOLERANCE_S.

RADAR.description: Monostatic radar: range, range rate, two-way Doppler, azimuth, elevation.

OPTICAL.description: Passive optical: right ascension and declination, magnitude.

PASSIVE_RF.description: Passive RF: angles and the received (one-way) frequency of a target's emitter.

MEMErrorModel.description:
Noise, bias and editing rules for one observable. Standard deviations and
biases use the observable's SI unit. ANGLE observables use radians.

MEMEditingDecision.description:
One deterministic editing decision. The observation identity is carried
from the tracking-data input so rejected sets can be compared exactly.

MEMAttestation.description:
Dual-form signature. Presence means both signatures are required and both
MUST verify independently; an invalid member rejects the record rather
than downgrading it to unsigned.

MEM.description:
Measurement Error Model. JSON projections preserve these IDL-capitalized
field names exactly. The FlatBuffer signature covers the size-prefixed
buffer with both signature vectors zeroed; the canonical-JSON signature
covers RFC 8785 canonical JSON with both signature fields omitted.

MJD.description: Modified Julian Date in UTC, e.g., 58119

X_POLE_WANDER_RADIANS.description: x component of Pole Wander in radians, e.g., 2.872908911518888E-7

Y_POLE_WANDER_RADIANS.description: y component of Pole Wander in radians, e.g., 1.2003259523750447E-6

X_CELESTIAL_POLE_OFFSET_RADIANS.description: x component of Celestial Pole Offset in radians, e.g., 5.720801437092525E-10

Y_CELESTIAL_POLE_OFFSET_RADIANS.description: y component of Celestial Pole Offset in radians, e.g., -8.484239419416879E-10

UT1_MINUS_UTC_SECONDS.description: UT1 minus UTC in seconds, e.g., 0.2163567

TAI_MINUS_UTC_SECONDS.description: TAI minus UTC in seconds, e.g., 37

LENGTH_OF_DAY_CORRECTION_SECONDS.description: Correction to Length of Day in seconds, e.g., 8.094E-4

SERIES.description:
Published series this row was taken from. Rows from different series are
NOT interchangeable at the microarcsecond level and must not be merged
without recording which series each row came from.

IERS_C04_14.description: IERS EOP 14 C04, the long-term combined solution (e.g. eopc04_14_IAU2000.62-now.txt).

IERS_C04_20.description: IERS EOP 20 C04, the ITRF2020-based combined solution.

IERS_BULLETIN_A.description: IERS Bulletin A rapid service / prediction.

FINALS2000A.description: USNO/IERS finals2000A combined rapid + prediction file.

OTHER.description: A series not covered above; identify it in a producer-defined way.

IAU_CONVENTION.description:
Precession-nutation model the celestial pole offsets are expressed
against. X_/Y_CELESTIAL_POLE_OFFSET_RADIANS are CIP offsets in the GCRS
(dX, dY) under the IAU 2000/2006 conventions; a consumer cannot apply
them correctly without knowing which model produced them.

X_POLE_WANDER_UNCERTAINTY_RADIANS.description: 1-sigma uncertainty in x Pole Wander, radians.

Y_POLE_WANDER_UNCERTAINTY_RADIANS.description: 1-sigma uncertainty in y Pole Wander, radians.

X_CELESTIAL_POLE_OFFSET_UNCERTAINTY_RADI.description: 1-sigma uncertainty in the x Celestial Pole Offset, radians.

Y_CELESTIAL_POLE_OFFSET_UNCERTAINTY_RADI.description: 1-sigma uncertainty in the y Celestial Pole Offset, radians.

UT1_MINUS_UTC_UNCERTAINTY_SECONDS.description: 1-sigma uncertainty in UT1 minus UTC, seconds.

LENGTH_OF_DAY_UNCERTAINTY_SECONDS.description: 1-sigma uncertainty in the Length of Day correction, seconds.

X_POLE_WANDER_RADIANS_HP.description:
x component of Pole Wander in radians, double precision. Authoritative
over X_POLE_WANDER_RADIANS when present.

Y_POLE_WANDER_RADIANS_HP.description:
y component of Pole Wander in radians, double precision. Authoritative
over Y_POLE_WANDER_RADIANS when present.

X_CELESTIAL_POLE_OFFSET_RADIANS_HP.description:
x component of the Celestial Pole Offset in radians, double precision.
Authoritative over X_CELESTIAL_POLE_OFFSET_RADIANS when present.

Y_CELESTIAL_POLE_OFFSET_RADIANS_HP.description:
y component of the Celestial Pole Offset in radians, double precision.
Authoritative over Y_CELESTIAL_POLE_OFFSET_RADIANS when present.

UT1_MINUS_UTC_SECONDS_HP.description:
UT1 minus UTC in seconds, double precision. Authoritative over
UT1_MINUS_UTC_SECONDS when present.

LENGTH_OF_DAY_CORRECTION_SECONDS_HP.description:
Correction to Length of Day in seconds, double precision. Authoritative
over LENGTH_OF_DAY_CORRECTION_SECONDS when present.

DATA_SET_EPOCH.description:
Epoch of the data set this row was published in, ISO 8601 UTC. Identifies
WHICH issue of the series a consumer is holding; two rows for the same
MJD from different data-set epochs are different values, not duplicates.

DATA_SET_CID.description:
Content identifier of the complete published data set this row was taken
from. Every frames consumer that must agree bit-for-bit records this so
the source is provable rather than assumed.

NUTATION_DPSI_RADIANS.description:
Nutation correction in longitude (dPsi) against the IAU 1980 model,
radians, as published beside the CIP offsets by combined rapid-service
series.

NUTATION_DEPS_RADIANS.description:
Nutation correction in obliquity (dEps) against the IAU 1980 model,
radians.

ACWStateSample.description: Target Cartesian state sample in an Earth-fixed frame.

JULIAN_DATE_TT.description: Sample epoch as Julian Date in TT.

VELOCITY_X_MPS.description:
Earth-fixed velocity, meters per second. Required for range-rate,
Doppler and frequency measurements (SIMULATE_OBSERVATIONS).

AZIMUTH_RAD.description: Azimuth, radians in the TopocentricFrame convention.

ELEVATION_RAD.description: Minimum visible elevation at the azimuth, radians.

ACWRefractionModel.description: Atmospheric refraction model for apparent-elevation access checks.

START_JULIAN_DATE_TT.description: Interval start as Julian Date in TT.

END_JULIAN_DATE_TT.description: Interval end as Julian Date in TT.

ACWGroundStation.description: Ground-station geodetic definition and scheduling constraints.

ALTITUDE_M.description: Height above the WGS-84 ellipsoid, meters.

CHANNEL_CAPACITY.description: Number of simultaneous contacts this station can schedule.

ACWConstraint.description: One access constraint. Fields not used by KIND are ignored.

MIN_ELEVATION.description: Observer-to-target elevation at or above THRESHOLD_RAD (ground observers).

MAX_RANGE.description: Observer-to-target range at or below MAX_RANGE_M.

MIN_RANGE.description: Observer-to-target range at or above MIN_RANGE_M.

SUN_EXCLUSION.description: Angle between the observer-to-target and observer-to-Sun directions at or above THRESHOLD_RAD (solar exclusion).

MOON_EXCLUSION.description: Angle between the observer-to-target and observer-to-Moon directions at or above THRESHOLD_RAD (lunar exclusion).

LINE_OF_SIGHT.description: Straight-line visibility between observer and target not occulted by the central body raised by OCCULTATION_ATMOSPHERE_HEIGHT_M (satellite-to-satellite).

OCCULTATION_ATMOSPHERE_HEIGHT_M.description:
Central-body radius offset for line-of-sight occultation, meters
(LINE_OF_SIGHT); 0 grazes the ellipsoid surface.

LABEL.description: Producer label echoed in window attribution.

ACWConstraintSet.description: A boolean composition of constraints and nested sets.

ANY_OF.description: At least one member must hold (OR).

SETS.description: Nested sets, combined with the same OPERATOR.

ACWObserverTrajectory.description:
A moving observer (spacecraft) given as pre-sampled Earth-fixed states, in
the same frame and time scale as ACWRequest.STATES.

ACWTargetSignature.description: Observable signature of a simulated target.

DIAMETER_M.description:
Diameter, meters, and geometric albedo of the diffuse sphere that sets
the magnitude, in the band of EOO.MAG (OPTICAL).

EMITTER_FREQUENCY_HZ.description:
Emitter carrier frequency, hertz, and EIRP toward the sensor, dBW
(PASSIVE_RF). A frequency of 0 means the target does not emit.

ACWTarget.description: One simulated target: truth states and signature.

STATES.description:
Truth Earth-fixed states with velocity, in the frame and time scale of
ACWRequest.STATES.

ACWSensor.description: A simulated sensor hosted by a ground station or an observer trajectory.

HOST_ID.description:
ACWGroundStation.STATION_ID or ACWObserverTrajectory.OBSERVER_ID of the
host.

RADAR.description: Monostatic radar: range, range rate, two-way Doppler, azimuth, elevation.

OPTICAL.description: Passive optical: right ascension and declination, magnitude.

PASSIVE_RF.description: Passive RF: angles and the received (one-way) frequency of a target's emitter.

ERROR_MODELS.description:
The measurements each observation carries, one error model per
measurement type (noise, bias, bias uncertainty, correlation time,
media and light-time options).

CONSTRAINTS.description:
Visibility for this sensor, the constraints its ACCESS windows were
computed with. When absent, ACWRequest.CONSTRAINTS apply.

OBSERVATION_INTERVAL_S.description: Seconds between observations within a track.

TRACK_DURATION_S.description: Longest track, seconds; 0 tracks the whole access window.

REVISIT_INTERVAL_S.description:
Shortest time between the end of one track of a target and the start
of the next, seconds.

REFERENCE_SNR_DB.description:
RADAR: signal-to-noise ratio, dB, of a REFERENCE_RCS_M2 target at
REFERENCE_RANGE_M; SNR scales with RCS and with range to the -4th power.

DETECTION_THRESHOLD_DB.description: RADAR and PASSIVE_RF: smallest detected signal-to-noise ratio, dB.

RECEIVER_G_OVER_T_DB_PER_K.description: PASSIVE_RF: receiver figure of merit, dB/K, and noise bandwidth, hertz.

LIMITING_MAGNITUDE.description:
OPTICAL: faintest magnitude detected, in the band of EOO.MAG; 0 applies
no magnitude limit.

MAX_HOST_SUN_ELEVATION_RAD.description:
OPTICAL: highest Sun elevation at the host for a detection, radians
(ground-based darkness); requires SUN_STATES. Observations scheduled
in brighter sky are lost.

FALSE_ALARM_RATE_PER_HOUR.description: Uncorrelated detections per hour of tracking, reported with UCT set.

TRANSMIT_FREQUENCY_HZ.description:
RADAR: transmitted carrier frequency, hertz. A DOPPLER error model
measures the echo's two-way shift relative to it, reported as $RDO
DOPPLER with DOPPLER_FREQUENCY set to this value.

ACWSensorAccess.description: Access windows of one sensor to one target (SIMULATE_OBSERVATIONS input).

ACWTrack.description: One simulated track: a sensor's scheduled look at a target.

DETECTED_COUNT.description: Observations that passed the detection test and were emitted.

LOSS_REASON.description:
Why scheduled observations were not detected (for example "SNR",
"MAGNITUDE"); empty when all were.

COMPUTE_ACCESS_WINDOWS.description: Compute access windows from pre-sampled target Cartesian states.

SIMULATE_OBSERVATIONS.description: Simulate sensor observations of TARGETS by SENSORS: schedule tracks inside the ACCESS windows (computed per sensor and target by COMPUTE_ACCESS_WINDOWS with that sensor's constraints), generate each measurement from the truth states with its MEMErrorModel noise and bias, apply the detection test, and add false alarms. The observations are emitted as separate $RDO (RADAR), $EOO (OPTICAL, LASER_RANGING) and $RFO (PASSIVE_RF) records; the result lists the tracks.

TARGET_STATION_ID.description: Optional target station id. Empty means all stations when supported.

MIN_ELEVATION_OVERRIDE_RAD.description: Optional caller override for minimum elevation, radians.

CONSTRAINTS.description:
Optional constraint composition. When absent the legacy behaviour holds:
every ground station's MIN_ELEVATION_RAD (or the override) plus
ELEVATION_MASK, all required.

OBSERVERS.description:
Optional moving observers (satellite-to-satellite access). Each observer
is evaluated against STATES like a ground station.

DISCRETE.description: Evaluate at the supplied sample epochs only; window edges are samples.

CONTINUOUS.description: Bracket between samples and refine each edge to ROOT_TOLERANCE_S.

ROOT_TOLERANCE_S.description: Edge refinement tolerance for CONTINUOUS, seconds.

SUN_STATES.description:
Sun states in the STATES frame and time scale, required by
SUN_EXCLUSION and TARGET_LIGHTING constraints; interpolated to sample epochs.

MOON_STATES.description: Moon states in the STATES frame and time scale, required by MOON_EXCLUSION.

ACCESS.description:
Where each sensor can see each target (SIMULATE_OBSERVATIONS); a pair
without an entry is never observed.

EARTH_ORIENTATION.description:
Earth orientation parameters for celestial directions (right ascension
and declination). When absent, polar motion, UT1-UTC and celestial pole
offsets are zero.

RANDOM_SEED.description:
Seed for measurement noise, biases and false alarms; one seed
reproduces the same observations.

START_JULIAN_DATE_TT.description:
Simulation span as Julian Dates in TT; 0 uses the span of the target
states.
Access start as Julian Date in TT.

END_JULIAN_DATE_TT.description: Access end as Julian Date in TT.

MAX_ELEVATION_RAD.description: Maximum elevation sampled or interpolated during the pass, radians.

SAMPLE_COUNT.description: Number of visible input samples contributing to the window.

OBSERVER_ID.description:
Observer id when the observer is an ACWObserverTrajectory; empty for a
ground station (then STATION_ID names it).

START_LIMITING_CONSTRAINT_INDEX.description:
Index into the flattened, depth-first constraint list of the constraint
whose transition opens the window; -1 when the window starts at the
first sample.

END_LIMITING_CONSTRAINT_INDEX.description:
Index of the constraint whose transition closes the window; -1 when the
window ends at the last sample.

START_LIMITING_CONSTRAINT_LABEL.description: Labels of those constraints, when the producer set them.

MIN_RANGE_M.description: Range extrema over the window, meters.

EDGES_REFINED.description: True when edges were root-refined (CONTINUOUS); false when they are samples.

ACWResult.description: Result for one access-window compute request.

INVALID_INPUT.description: Request fields are missing, non-finite, or numerically invalid.

UNSUPPORTED_OPERATION.description: The requested operation is not supported by the module.

TRACE_ID.description: Caller trace/correlation identifier copied from the request when present.

DISCRETE.description: Evaluate at the supplied sample epochs only; window edges are samples.

CONTINUOUS.description: Bracket between samples and refine each edge to ROOT_TOLERANCE_S.

CONSTRAINT_LABELS.description: Flattened depth-first constraint list the window indices refer to.
